text:
clara: Opened a draft PR to update audit-log examples and migration checklist: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/601 (WIP). Need SOC2-safe language around tenant identifiers and an SDK example in JS.
tom: paste the current example?
clara: current snippet in docs: 
```json
{"tenant_id": "org_900", "actor": "lee@example.com", "event": "create_resource"}
```
jay: For auditors we should stop showing tenant_id. Recommend tenant_hash and describe the transformation as HMAC/SHA-256 with a secret salt stored in KMS.
rachel-legal: Legal preference: "Tenant identifiers are pseudonymized using a salted HMAC-SHA256 (tenant_hash). Mapping tables, if maintained, are access-restricted and access is audited. Audit exports are encrypted at rest and subject to retention policies." Also request a short sentence about default retention and how customers can change it.
clara: thinking of wording: "Audit logs record tenant identifiers as tenant_hash values derived via a secret-salted HMAC-SHA256. Any mapping material is kept separately, access-restricted, and access to it is logged for auditing and incident response. Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default retention is 120 days and can be configured via export.retention_days." OK?
tom: sounds good. One nit: use phrase 'audited access' instead of 'access is logged' to match SOC2 wording.
rachel-legal: Replace with: '...mapping material is access-restricted and only accessible via audited access controls.' Also ask to call out KMS/HSM for salt storage.
jay: I'll add a short JS SDK migration snippet showing client.audit.logEvent with tenantHash and a comment: do not log raw tenant IDs. Different from Python examples in other threads.
link-bot: Preview: https://deploy.previews.redwood/601 build passed; link-check found one broken anchor in api-reference#audit-exports, pushing nav fix.
clara: proposed JS snippet added to PR:
```javascript
// produce tenantHash via HMAC-SHA256 and secret salt from KMS
const crypto = require('crypto');
const raw = 'tenant:acme';
const salt = await getSaltFromKms(); // store salt in KMS/HSM
const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', salt).update(raw).digest('hex');
await client.audit.logEvent({ tenantHash: hmac, actor: null, event: 'create_resource' });
// NOTE: do not emit raw tenant identifiers in logs or exports
```
tom: add one-line migration checklist item: "Rotate secret salt when rotating keys; contact support for enterprise migration help."
rachel-legal: Approved with edits: include exact phrase 'audited access controls' and mention KMS/HSM. LGTM otherwise.
clara: added checklist item and fixed API anchor per link-bot. CI green.
tom: once legal signoff is in i'll merge. Any objections?
rachel-legal: LGTM. Conservatively worded.
clara: merging now. :shipit: I'll follow up with a tiny FAQ: 'Why tenantHash?' explaining privacy and easier compliance. Closing thread.
jay: thanks all.
clara: thanks!
